verdict.rationale: Proa is a typed Rust UI framework, so AI-generated component tests are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows agent-facing material (AGENTS.md with validation commands, llms-full.txt), compile-time-checked props, and signals for islands. None of it documents any capability, AI-driven or otherwise, that generates component-level tests from declared props or reactive state. Build-time WCAG checks and lint or format verification are adjacent controls, not test generation.

support.subject: As an ai-native developer, I can have AI generate component-level tests based on the props and reactive state my component declares
